reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Usually just fatigue and nerve excitability after hard work, more common when you're dehydrated, low on electrolytes, or under-slept. If it's an occasional twitch here and there, not a big deal. If it's constant, spreading, or comes with weakness or numbness, get that checked by a doctor rather than guessing. Make sure you're drinking enough and getting enough sleep, and see if it settles."}
